d:
Dharavahik - ek prem katha (bhartiy sahity ki prem kathayen)
Pataktha,sanvad evan nirdeshan - basu chatarji
Ek prem katha bhartiy sahity aur vibhinn shastriy evan chuninda kahaniyon ki shrrinkhla hai | yah dharavahik bhartiy sahityakaron ki behatrin rachna aur manviy mulyon ko ukerti hai jismen rishton,bhavnaon aur prem ki ek jhalak dekhne ko milti hai | dharavahik alag-alag prishthabhumi,vicharon aur parivesh se aane vale kirdaron aur unke jivan men pyar ke vibhinn rupon ki manmohak tasvir ko dikhata hai |
